record.name: Ahrefs
record.one_liner: Ahrefs provides REST APIs and developer tools for marketing and search data, including site explorer, keywords explorer, rank tracker, and an integration program called Ahrefs Connect.

auth.notes: API requests require an API key sent in the Authorization header as a Bearer token (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY). Ahrefs Connect also uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE.

access.notes: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans and includes limited free test queries, but joining the Ahrefs Connect integration program requires submitting an application form.

api_surface.notes: Provides a REST API (API v3) with an OpenAPI-compatible specification.

mcp.notes: Ahrefs documents Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for connecting Ahrefs data to AI assistants and agents such as Claude and ChatGPT.

buildability.reasoning: Standard API usage requires an eligible paid plan and an API key from account settings, while third-party apps via Ahrefs Connect require an application review and approval process.
